title: First Blood
description: You've proven yourself to Gormund, which means he's decided you're worth more to him alive and fighting than dead in round one. Three rounds: pit fighters same as you, a beast handler's stock that's cheaper to lose than a fighter, then whoever's holding the tier-one belt and has no intention of handing it over. Gormund sells tickets to all three either way.

objectives.description: Register for the Bloodsand Gauntlet with Gormund
Survive Round 1: The Pit Fighters (0/3 opponents)
Survive Round 2: The Beast Handlers (0/2 beasts)
Survive Round 3: take the belt off whoever's holding it

notes: First tier arena combat quest. Unlocks after completing the novice tournament. Keeps Gormund's profit motive consistent across the arena three (meet_the_arena_master, arena_tournament, arena_tier_1) and frames opponents as people with their own stakes in the pit, per spec, rather than a scoreboard.
